title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Automattic WP Job…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Automattic WP Job Manager versions up to 2.4.10 due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This flaw allows an attacker with low privileges to inject code that can be executed in the context of other users' browsers. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
